research_objects.title: Marketing pro AI startupy & SaaS: copywriting a SEO pro vývojáře LLM a aplikací umělé inteligence
research_objects.description: An author-written professional article exploring the reciprocal relationship between professional communication expertise and AI products. It explains how SEO, copywriting, journalism/PR, psychology, and cross-domain commercial experience can help AI startups and SaaS developers with brand discoverability, positioning, product communication, audience understanding, and translating technical capabilities into customer-relevant language. It also compares major AI systems through their practical strengths, limitations, and workarounds from the perspective of an information professional.

research_processes.title: Cross-model E-E-A-T assessments and independent meta-analyses
research_processes.summary: A multi-model assessment sequence examined the author's professional digital identity and SEO pillar page through distinct E-E-A-T reports. The currently verified SlideShare series contains nine directly reviewed model-specific first-order assessments, alongside independent secondary meta-analyses published under Gemini 3 Deep Research, Kimi, Claude, and ChatGPT. The meta-analysis source sets do not fully agree on the Gemini model version: the Claude synthesis names Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview, while Kimi and ChatGPT name Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. The 2.5 reference remains a separate inventory lead. Some first-order reports may also have shared-chat, web, or archive manifestations already registered elsewhere; those cross-platform identities remain separate until their content is compared. A separate 12-slide Gemini Deep Research report titled Spektrografie digitální identity Daniela Beránka applies a transdisciplinary E-E-A-T and semantic analysis to the broader professional-ethnography object; it is retained as an independent analysis, not folded into the first-order SEO-pillar report series or the four meta-analyses. A separate Claude-led E-E-A-T/semiotic analysis of the broader professional ethnography is represented by a nine-slide first edition and a ten-slide v2 revision. The v2 page explicitly describes additions of structured data, external references, and DIO-priority evidence; these reports are distinct from the first-order SEO-pillar report series and from the four meta-analyses.
